items.test_result: Protected registrations now require hashed strategy/model/data/rights/calendar/universe/cost/benchmark identity, a frozen schedule, and an approval scope equal to the charter hash. The durable registry refuses same-version identity changes and replays its chain after restart; changing an identity component changes the charter digest.

A closed cohort's outcome is immutable; changing its benchmark or endpoint under the same charter version is rejected. Registry recovery revalidates cohort membership, frozen endpoint and content-addressed outcome before accepting a closure. A later version must link the previous charter hash and move the prospective start forward.

Shared evidence classification labels shadow, fixture/historical replay, local paper, and independently attested forward separately. Fixture CLI summaries, daily and intraday reports, option replay/forward results, execution audits, statistical export rows, and live-paper evidence tiers carry derived labels; replay and local paper cannot be upgraded without observed data, a sealed pre-entry decision, a complete session, and verified custody where independent claims are made. The generic exporter cannot assert deployment validation. Focused suite: 85 passed; Ruff and mypy pass.

The Q4 2026 13/13 budget refuses a protected cohort without both a human trial approval and governance amendment. Prospective cohorts require exact charter-hash approval and full identity/schedule/durable registry; a direct regression confirms no unapproved cohort is appended. The next research window still requires human approval.

A durable append-only log allows only source/timestamp/schema corruption reasons, requires a second distinct human approval scoped to the exact request, revalidates on restart, and refuses outcome edits. Sensitivity reports retain every scheduled day, show approved exclusions and unresolved missing days, include fixed-denominator zero-fill and -100% adverse cases, and disable promotion when exclusions or missing dates exist. Eight focused tests pass.
blockers: Reviewer actor IDs and human status are supplied by the caller; production identity/authentication must independently verify the reviewer before this can be treated as externally independent review
